title: Uruguayan Beef Empanadas in Chinese Style
description: A fusion twist on the classic Uruguayan empanada, with a Chinese-inspired twist on the filling and a crispy pastry crust.
instructions: 2. In a large skillet or wok, heat 2 tablespoons of sesame oil over medium-high heat.
3. Add the ground beef to the skillet and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until it is no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
4. Add the soy sauce, sugar, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir to combine.
5. Stir in the cornstarch and cook for 1 minute.
6. Add the Chinese BBQ sauce to the skillet and stir to combine.
7. Roll out the empanada dough on a floured surface to a thickness of about 1/8 inch.
8. Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass.
9. Place a tablespoon of the beef mixture in the center of each circle of dough.
10. Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-circle shape and press the edges together to seal.
11. Brush the tops of the empanadas with sesame oil and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
